counts.scope: All 72 authored .tres module resources; all finite standalone geometry factories listed in extract_modules.gd, including 51 forest results/variants; every accepted Foundry phrase and itinerary in the pinned batch.
limits: Does not enumerate infinitely many seeded whole maps or their generated inline connectors.
Standalone module geometry does not include enemies/Bosses placed by a full-stage encounter consumer.
Godot data factories are evaluated; no gameplay/physics acceptance is inferred.
Proposed catalogue entries with no build implementation are not fabricated.
Historical alternatives and current candidates are categorized; library inclusion does not mean production admission.

interpretation.forest_signature_warning: Path/method/logical string argument only; numeric variants collapsed. Not assessed gameplay-family or certified-template count.
interpretation.integration_label_warning: development/formal/unverified record old source consumer usage, not foundation certification or human approval.

fidelity.transform: Recorded editorTranslation only, no scaling for checked resource rectangles. Actor markers and interpolated routes are not collision/replay evidence.
fidelity.preferred_migration_input: Exact TRES/GDScript/TSCN/JSON bytes plus original evaluated dictionaries; editor canvas/SVG are reference views.
approximations: Action-program entries without position are linearly interpolated spawn-to-goal by build_library.convert_forest.
Route duration/sample phase positions illustrate intent, not executed input trajectories.
Bell marker30x40 differs from real ShotLatch collision28x34; entry30x53 differs from player24x36.
Hazard/spike SVG/editor proxies are not runtime collision construction.

remote_runtime_differences.read_method: GitHub fetch_file pinned ref; original UTF-8 content blob verified
remote_runtime_differences.unified_diff_from_local:
--- local-game-and-harness/scripts/player/jump_ability.gd
+++ 879b39e/scripts/player/jump_ability.gd
@@ -168,3 +168,10 @@
 	_air_max = maximum_jumps()
 	used_jumps = 1
 	_coyote_remaining = 0.0
+
+# Equipment changes occur while paused, without an advance() tick between them.
+# Record any capacity decrease immediately; growing capacity cannot grant actions
+# in this flight. maximum_jumps retains separately unlocked core abilities.
+func reconcile_capacity() -> void:
+	var maximum := maximum_jumps()
+	_air_max = maximum if _air_max < 0 else mini(_air_max, maximum)

remote_runtime_differences.read_method: GitHub fetch_file pinned ref; original UTF-8 content blob verified
remote_runtime_differences.unified_diff_from_local:
--- local-game-and-harness/scripts/player/traversal_ability.gd
+++ 879b39e/scripts/player/traversal_ability.gd
@@ -51,6 +51,14 @@
 	else: return false
 	if not enabled: cancel()
 	return true
+
+# Query the independent core-ability owner; equipment never grants these rights.
+func has_capability(id: StringName) -> bool:
+	match id:
+		&"double_jump": return double_enabled
+		&"wall_climb": return wall_enabled
+		&"grapple": return hook_enabled
+	return false
 
 func busy() -> bool:
 	return state in [&"hook_cast", &"hook_fly", &"hook_pull", &"hook_miss", &"hook_retract", &"hook_contact_kick"]

remote_runtime_differences.unified_diff_from_local:
--- local-game-and-harness/scripts/combat/action_resources.gd
+++ 879b39e/scripts/combat/action_resources.gd
@@ -38,3 +38,8 @@
 
 func can_grant_shot() -> bool:
 	return shot_charges < mini(_flight_cap, tuning.max_air_shots)
+
+# Preserve flight spending and pending shots across paused equipment changes.
+func reconcile_capacity() -> void:
+	_flight_cap = mini(_flight_cap,tuning.max_air_shots)
+	shot_charges = mini(shot_charges,_flight_cap)

--- local-game-and-harness/scripts/player/jump_ability.gd
+++ 879b39e/scripts/player/jump_ability.gd
@@ -168,3 +168,10 @@
 	_air_max = maximum_jumps()
 	used_jumps = 1
 	_coyote_remaining = 0.0
+
+# Equipment changes occur while paused, without an advance() tick between them.
+# Record any capacity decrease immediately; growing capacity cannot grant actions
+# in this flight. maximum_jumps retains separately unlocked core abilities.
+func reconcile_capacity() -> void:
+	var maximum := maximum_jumps()
+	_air_max = maximum if _air_max < 0 else mini(_air_max, maximum)
